'''Dwaine''', also spelt '''Dwayne''', is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]] and [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. A mechanic who is usually seen with best friend [[Jethro]], he is voiced by [[Navid Khonsari]], who also voiced pedestrians in [[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]] and [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories]], and has directed ''San Andreas''.

==Character history==
Dwaine, at some point prior to [[1986]], had become a skilled mechanic working on marine engines along side best friend [[Jethro]] at their [[Boatyard|boatyard]] in [[Viceport]], [[Vice City in GTA III Era|Vice City]].<ref>From the mission ''[[Wear Flowers In Your Hair]]'':<br />'''The Truth''': "C'mon, man, there's these two guys I know - used to work on marine engines, 'til the mob bought their business over in Vice."</ref> The two, seemingly comfortable in Vice City, sell their business to [[Vercetti Gang|mob]] [[Gang Leaders|boss]] [[Tommy Vercetti]]. The two, prior to [[1989]], leave Vice City after they could no longer return to the boatyard and settled down in [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]]. The two attend the '89 Fierro Love In, located in [[San Fierro]], where they met [[The Truth]], an aging hippie who began selling them drugs from his farm in [[Leafy Hollow]].

Dwayne, presumably unable to find work as a mechanic, began selling hotdogs from a [[Hotdog|hotdog van]] at the tram terminal in [[King's]], San Fierro. The Truth, having befriended [[Doherty Garage|garage]] owner [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]], suggests Dwayne and Jethro as good mechanics for the garage and both are later hired. Dwayne and Jethro continue to appear at Carl's garage, initially seen to be [[Deconstruction|working on a car]], [[Zeroing In|playing cards]] with Carl and his garage business partner [[Cesar Vialpando]], [[Test Drive|looking at a car]] and [[Puncture Wounds|sitting at a table]] with Carl.

==Trivia==
*Dwaine can be seen wearing a t-shirt with the [[Rockstar Games]] logo during the cutscene after [[Tommy Vercetti]] purchases the [[Boatyard]].
*Unused audio file along with their associated subtitles in GTA Vice City suggested that Dwaine and [[Jethro]] were also to appear in "[[The Fastest Boat]]" for [[Ricardo Diaz]].<ref>''Audio\cok3_*.wav''<br>''text\american.gxt>MAIN>COK3_*''<br><code>Don't shoot, dude!
What's in this stuff?
He's taking the boat. Bummer.
Help! Some square's stealing the boat, man!</code></ref>
